name: Quoted ability keeps its own condition; equipped creature is attacking
notes: Memory: project_quoted_condition_and_attached_subject_2026-11-11. Giant's Amulet: the trailing 'as long as' normaliser (Pattern B) lifted the quote's 'as long as it's untapped' onto the whole line, so the +0/+1 was conditional and the granted text was cut to 'This creature has hexproof' (twice). Pattern B now skips a condition inside a quote (_insideQuote), the quoted 'This creature has <keyword> as long as <condition>' gives the keyword to the wearer only while the condition holds on it (_parseGrantedGlobalAbilities), and the quoted-grant dedupe ignores the closing period. Sedge Sliver: 'This creature gets +1/+1 as long as you control a Swamp' granted to all Slivers now boosts each Sliver whose controller has a Swamp. Ace's Baseball Bat: 'As long as equipped creature is attacking, it has first strike' read 'equipped' as the condition (always true on the wearer); _parseCondition now reads 'equipped/enchanted/fortified <noun> is/has ...' as 'it ...' against the permanent the card is attached to.

$includes: This creature has hexproof as long as it is untapped.

$excludes: This creature has hexproof as long as it is untapped
